title: Unify FLASH/FSDIR backends: shared ops, merged struct, alphabetical slots
description: The USB flash and FSDIR backends share identical sign/verify/decrypt logic and keystore format but duplicate ~300 LOC. The g_slots struct has separate flash_path/fsdir_path and keystore/fsdir_keystore fields that can be collapsed. Slot ordering is insertion-order (nondeterministic). This epic tracks three improvements: (1) extract shared keystore ops into wp11_backend_keystore.c, removing duplication; (2) collapse flash_path+fsdir_path->keystore_path and keystore+fsdir_keystore->keystore in g_slots; merge slot_add_flash/slot_add_fsdir into slot_add_keystore; (3) sort C_GetSlotList output alphabetically by keystore_path for predictable slot-to-file mapping.
